args.summary: Completed the reviewable Stage 4 schematic capture through the original validated-proposal and deterministic intent workflow. Fresh draft contains the exact ten fitted BOM parts, six functional nets, four captioned groups and seven intentional no-connects; VBUS_RAW and +5V_PROTECTED remain distinct around U1 and both outputs/LED use the common protected path. Actual verify_symbols reports 11 definitions matching installed libraries or exact engine power templates with no divergences; ERC and BOM/PINOUT drift are clean, legibility has zero errors with one documented nonblocking low-utilization advisory, and all seven assigned footprint types resolve. Draft score is 91.38/100. PINOUT, SPEC, BOM, SUBSYSTEMS, firmware evidence and constraints are synchronized; full document readback completed and revisit obligations were reconciled. The embedded U1 definition still carries disclosed inherited TPS2051C/0.5A descriptive metadata, while the actual TPS2065CDBVR instance, verified pins, footprint and BOM are correct; exact-device ratings must come from the sourced BOM, and standalone library reuse requires supported metadata correction. This is software schematic completion only. Electrical targets are unchanged; the 0.831 mA ledger remains conditional, all physical/current/fault/thermal/visibility/assembly/procurement validation remains pending, and no PCB/DRC, manufacturing release or downstream stage completion is claimed. The actual non-programmable schematic confirms firmware not applicable at captured-design level while preserving the real later firmware stage.
